title: Splayed Ladder Bookcase
description: One original complete freestanding splayed ladder bookcase. Two continuous thick A-shaped side cheeks each enclose a genuine large tapered through-opening; four complete shallow three-sided shelf trays narrow in depth as they rise between the sloping supports. The shelves remain horizontal, with open fronts and finite raised rear/side retainers. Original whole support geometry, not a straight backed bookcase resized or an old four-upright cooling/nursery rack with more shelves. Empty static furniture only; no included books, load rating, climbability, stability, anti-tip, ergonomic or installation guarantee.
